product.name: AI Agent Building Platform
product.description: A platform enabling teams to design, develop, and launch AI agents without coding, using any AI models and integrations.

product.name: Workflow Builder
product.description: Allows teams to create advanced sequences of conversational steps and logic for AI agents.

product.name: Knowledge Base
product.description: A scalable vector database for organizing and managing thousands of data sources for AI agents.

product.name: Agent CMS
product.description: Centralizes and manages agent content like prompts, variables, intents, and components in one place.

product.name: API Library
product.description: Offers APIs for custom integrations with tech stacks, interfaces, and data sources.

product.name: Prototyping Tool
product.description: Enables testing of AI agent builds in real-time and sharing with stakeholders for feedback.
